subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before merging this timing change?
rationale: The source-level fix is narrow and plausible, but the reported failure is user-visible session/tool-result behavior in a real channel and the external PR has only synthetic/unit-level proof.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source/test proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on the shared-helper diff and focused regression tests while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 if no one can produce real channel or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The session guard and synthetic tool-result behavior were introduced in this area, making this the best available owner for proof-sufficiency judgment.
